title: ci: publish chart with app RC version on main push
body: ## Summary Aligns chart and app versioning so both artifacts receive the same tags on every event: 1. **New `helm-publish` job in `ci.yaml`** — runs on every main push and publishes the Helm chart with `--version` and `--app-version` set to the same RC version tag the image receives from the `oci-build` reusable workflow. This ensures chart and app tags stay in lockstep for RC builds. 2. **Added Cosign signing to `helm-publish.yaml`** — the release-time chart publishing workflow now also signs charts with keyless Cosign (Sigstore OIDC), consistent with the new CI helm-publish job and the image signing already in place. **Before:** On main pushes, the app image was published with an RC tag (e.g. `0.3.1-rc.20260414194220.b286051`) but no chart was published. Charts were only published on release events, unsigned. **After:** On main pushes, both the app image and Helm chart are published with the same RC version. On releases, both are published with the release semver. All chart artifacts are now Cosign-signed. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Merge the prerequisite PR in `bcit-tlu/.github` ([#5](https://github.com/bcit-tlu/.github/pull/5)) first — adds `rc_version` / `changed` outputs to `oci-build.yaml`. Until that lands, the helm-publish job will gracefully skip (empty version guard). - [ ] After both PRs are merged, verify a main push produces a chart in GHCR with the same version tag as the app image: `ghcr.io/bcit-tlu/technical-operations-documentation/charts/tech-ops-docs:` - [ ] Verify the chart's `appVersion` matches the image tag by inspecting the published OCI artifact ### Notes Depends on https://github.com/bcit-tlu/.github/pull/5. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/c9c8c3ce533d4ff88d5015f0d9b32edb Requested by: @kphunter ---
